card.name: Words just before 'switching' patients
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation right before a form of switch or convert, when a patient is moved from one drug or formulation to another. Seen in dosing sections on switching therapies.

modes.label: Linking word before switching
modes.description: A word like when, is, be or an open parenthesis that comes just before switched or switching patients.
modes.example: Dosage adjustments are recommended to lower the risk of hypoglycemia<< when>> switching patients to LEVEMIR from

modes.label: Passive before converted or switched
modes.description: Auxiliary verbs such as is or be before a verb for changing a patient to another product.
modes.example: Patients receiving immediate release glipizide may<< be>> switched to glipizide extended-release

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word switch or switching next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug-switching verb such as switching or converted.
